renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Short words. Concrete images. No jargon, no Sanskrit terms, no meta-commentary.

paragraphs.text: No shepherd needed to know why. Your own power piles up the world. Standing and dissolving are one. Going on, rejecting nothing — you know. Pleasure and pain just get watched. Free from that, alone.

Deluded but doing. Drop difference, act in other worlds. Feel your own power and taste it. Three steps keep everything alive. Steady mind speaks among outer body-senses. Chatter carries the carried-outward away.

When the climbed is measured, its fading fades your life. Element-wrapped, then free again — equal to the Lord, highest. Breath links naturally. Nose-middle held: what is here, in side and middle streams? Again, may there be re-closing.
